<issue>Issue Title: Issues with writing file names
Description:
Hi, great tool!
I just starting trying it, and I'm running into some issues.
Initially, I was encountering the same problem as detailed in this issue: https://github.com/AntonOsika/gpt-engineer/issues/167. Fortunately, I noticed you fixed this and after pulling the changes, that issue was resolved.
However, I'm now facing another issue related to file name generation. The program is formatting file names as '`filename`':
![image](https://github.com/AntonOsika/gpt-engineer/assets/25695071/6fe9db63-3b14-481d-8182-8c8ed5e9f75f)
At other (most) times, it's formatting them as '[filename]', which is resulting in file outputs like this:
![image](https://github.com/AntonOsika/gpt-engineer/assets/25695071/801f1da0-6968-4001-9bba-882d0db40c42)
I suspect this might have something to do with this commit: https://github.com/AntonOsika/gpt-engineer/commit/8180f0346c8a380637b72212432aa9abd5c04a9c#diff-945067bb601867dd64fd5ae92de9bf829da8545700835ac49744902ddec355fd
I'm using gpt-3.5-turbo since I don't have access to gpt-4 yet. Maybe the model is not as smart to understand this prompt?
</issue>
